questions.question: How do layouts and partials fit into Rails MVC views?
questions.title: Layouts and Partials in MVC Views
questions.direct_answer: In the view layer, layouts and partials organize HTML. A layout (application.html.erb) is the shell that wraps every action: <head>, nav, and <%= yield %> where the action's view renders. A partial (_form.html.erb) is a reusable snippet rendered with render 'form'. MVC-wise: the controller renders the action's view, that view renders inside the layout, and both can render partials. So a page is composed: layout wraps the view, the view reuses partials. This keeps HTML DRY — the nav lives in the layout, a shared form in a partial, and the action's unique content in its view. Use partials for repeated UI (cards, forms) and layouts for the page frame.

interviewer_intent.testing: Whether you know a layout wraps the action view (yield) and a partial is a reusable snippet (render 'name'), composing a page DRY.
interviewer_intent.common_mistake: Forgetting yield in the layout (no action content), or naming a partial without the underscore.
interviewer_intent.to_stand_out: Layout = shell wrapping the action (yield); partial = reusable snippet (render 'name'). A page composes layout -> view -> partials. Keeps HTML DRY.

A partial (_form.html.erb) is a reusable snippet, rendered with render 'form'.

The controller renders the action view; the layout wraps it automatically.

sections.content: In the view layer, layouts and partials organize HTML. A layout (application.html.erb) is the shell that wraps every action: head, nav, and yield where the action's view renders. A partial (_form.html.erb) is a reusable snippet rendered with render form. MVC-wise: the controller renders the action's view, that view renders inside the layout, and both can render partials. So a page is composed: layout wraps the view, the view reuses partials. This keeps HTML DRY — the nav lives in the layout, a shared form in a partial, and the action's unique content in its view. Use partials for repeated UI like cards and forms, and layouts for the page frame. A common mistake is forgetting yield in the layout, so no action content shows, and naming a partial without the leading underscore.

sections.title: Build the mental model
sections.content:
In the view layer, layouts and partials organize HTML.

A layout (application.html.erb) is the shell that wraps every action: <head>, nav, and <%= yield %> where the action's view renders.

A common mistake is forgetting yield in the layout (no action content), or naming a partial without the underscore.

sections.title: Page Composition
sections.content:
layout -> view -> partials. Layout wraps with yield; partials reuse snippets.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  L[layout: application.html.erb] --> Y[yield -> action view]
  V[action view] --> P[render 'form' -> _form.html.erb]
  P --> S[shared: 'shared/nav']
```
